serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: I decided on a movie I want to watch.
You: Really? What is it?
Bot: It was hard to choose. Almost everything in the cinema is a sequel of something, but lucky for us, one of the major franchises is remaking their cinematic universe.
You: Lucky us, huh.
You: What’s the title?
Bot: ‘Rockaya: Beginning’. Re-imagining of one of the most popular series. Since the original actor is now too old to play his character and he didn’t consent to be replaced by CGI, holders of the IP decided to update the story to better suit modern audiences.
You: I liked the original. Last fight is a legendary piece of cinema. What did they change?
Bot: I don’t want to spoil too much, but Rockaya’s background and motivation changed a little. At least that’s what the description says.
You: Doesn’t sound too bad. Sometimes these remakes go too far.
Bot: So far, all critics gave it top scores.
You: If that’s the case, we gotta go watch it.
